punchline: Nicholas Carr used to dive in the sea of words and found himself skimming it like a Jet Ski.
thirty_sec: Nicholas Carr read deeply for years. Then, a few pages into a book, his mind began to slip away. He realised the internet had trained him to scan and to jump to the next stimulus. He turned the question from what the internet gives us to how our tools rebuild our attention, and The Shallows grew out of that question.
